message.content:
Sure! If you’re looking for a machine that can bake a chocolate cake for you, here are a few great options:

| Machine | Why it’s great for chocolate cake | Typical price range |
|---------|-----------------------------------|---------------------|
| **Conventional electric oven** | The most common choice. You can bake at a precise temperature (usually 350 °F/175 °C) and control the bake time. | $200–$800 |
| **Convection oven** | Uses a fan to circulate hot air, giving a more even bake and often reducing cooking time by 10–15 %. | $300–$1,200 |
| **Smart oven (e.g., June Oven, Tovala, Anova Precision Oven)** | Connects to Wi‑Fi, offers pre‑set recipes, and can automatically adjust temperature and time. Great for beginners. | $400–$1,500 |
| **Bread/cake maker (e.g., Hamilton Beach 2‑in‑1 Bread & Cake Maker)** | Designed specifically for baking cakes and breads. Just add ingredients, set “cake” mode, and let it do the work. | $80–$150 |
| **Air fryer** | Works well for small cakes or cupcakes. It’s quick and uses less oil. | $80–$250 |
| **Microwave with a cake‑baking setting** | Ideal for a quick, single‑serving chocolate cake. | $50–$200 |

**Quick tip:** If you’re new to baking, a smart oven or a dedicated cake maker can simplify the process—just follow the on‑screen instructions and you’ll get a perfectly baked chocolate cake in no time. If you prefer full control, a conventional or convection oven is the way to go. Happy baking!
